facts.fact: WHO's SCORE assessment rates Mauritius's civil registration data as exchanged electronically from local to regional offices and then to central offices, 'electronic at all levels'; the assessment uses data from 2013 to 2018 and was updated on 15 March 2021, and it does not say how the record is entered at the office.

WHO's SCORE assessment covers the registration of both births and deaths in Mauritius, giving completeness of 100% for each and electronic exchange of the data at all levels, on data from 2013 to 2018.

systems.tiers: local, regional and central offices; registration locations rated as full coverage including rural areas

note: Both values rest on one scorecard line about electronic exchange of data between office levels, not on a statement that the office enters the event digitally at registration; no office count is given, and as_of is the last year of the assessment's 2013-2018 data.
